notes.history: Current value, trailing three calendar-day mean and sample SD, and adjacent-day change. No future or other-person records; insufficient history remains missing, never zero fluctuation.
notes.smoothing: Zero retains the current score. One, two and four-day half-lives span short causal memory below the seven-day forecast horizon; select only on development people, not a claim of optimal biological windows.
notes.models: Three decade-spaced ridge strengths and four shallow boosted-tree settings allow nonlinear interactions with limited capacity for 60 development people. No row-random early stopping. Both matched arms receive exactly this search budget.
notes.names: Temporal DNB is causal smoothing of the existing personal DNB. History plus DNB is a supervised combined warning model and must not be called pure DNB.
notes.evaluation: Unchanged people, outcomes, monitoring days and notification policy. Historical constructed data are already inspected; all results are exploratory. Freeze thresholds on calibration people before testing. Preserve all methods, including failures.
